1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Ship moves horizontally at bottom, asteroids fall and increase speed.
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8: 
9: // Ship definition
10: const ship = {
11:   width: 40,
12:   height: 20,
13:   x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
14:   y: canvas.height - 30,
15:   speed: 5,
16:   moveLeft: false,
17:   moveRight: false,
18:   draw() {
19:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
20:     ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
21:   },
22:   update() {
23:     if (this.moveLeft) this.x = Math.max(0, this.x - this.speed);
24:     if (this.moveRight) this.x = Math.min(canvas.width - this.width, this.x + this.speed);
25:   }
26: };
27: 
28: // Asteroid pool
29: let asteroids = [];
30: let spawnTimer = 0;
31: let spawnInterval = 90; // frames
32: let speedFactor = 1;
33: let gameOver = false;
34: let score = 0;
35: 
36: function spawnAsteroid() {
37:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
38:   asteroids.push({
39:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
40:     y: -size,
41:     size,
42:     speed: 2 * speedFactor + Math.random() * 2
43:   });
44: }
45: 
46: function updateAsteroids() {
47:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
48:     const a = asteroids[i];
49:     a.y += a.speed;
50:     // remove if off screen
51:     if (a.y > canvas.height) {
52:       asteroids.splice(i, 1);
53:       score++;
54:       // gradually increase difficulty
55:       if (score % 10 === 0) speedFactor += 0.2;
56:     } else if (collision(a, ship)) {
57:       gameOver = true;
58:     }
59:   }
60: }
61: 
62: function drawAsteroids() {
63:   ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
64:   for (const a of asteroids) {
65:     ctx.beginPath();
66:     ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
67:     ctx.fill();
68:   }
69: }
70: 
71: function collision(ast, shp) {
72:   return (
73:     ast.x < shp.x + shp.width &&
74:     ast.x + ast.size > shp.x &&
75:     ast.y < shp.y + shp.height &&
76:     ast.y + ast.size > shp.y
77:   );
78: }
79: 
80: function drawScore() {
81:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
82:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
83:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
84: }
85: 
86: function gameLoop() {
87:   if (gameOver) {
88:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
89:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
90:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
91:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
92:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height / 2);
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
94:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
95:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, canvas.width / 2 - 50, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
96:     return;
97:   }
98: 
99:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
100: 
101:   ship.update();
102:   ship.draw();
103: 
104:   if (spawnTimer++ >= spawnInterval) {
105:     spawnAsteroid();
106:     spawnTimer = 0;
107:     // slightly speed up spawns
